name: URA Finale
description: The baseline training scenario. Balanced stat gains and no special mechanics.
notes: Great for first-timers; rewards balanced builds.

name: Aoharu Cup
description: Team-based training. Strong friendship and racing bonuses; emphasizes power and pace skills.
notes: Power builds shine. Teammates fill the deck dynamically.

name: Make a New Track
description: Continuous racing scenario. Rewards consistent racing performance and skill accumulation.
notes: Stamina-heavy umas with strong recovery skills thrive.

name: Grand Live
description: Idol-themed scenario. Performance tokens unlock extra skills and stat bonuses.
notes: Skill-heavy builds — extra skill points from performance tokens.

name: Grand Masters
description: Past/present/future training arcs grant powerful inherited skills.
notes: Best for late-game players chasing top scores. High skill ceiling.

name: U.A.F. Ready Go!
description: Athletic disciplines (Sphere/Field/Stride) provide stat-track training bonuses.
notes: Most flexible recent scenario; rewards focused stat builds.

name: Project L'Arc
description: Overseas expedition. Aptitude-overcoming training, big stat ceilings.
notes: Strong for medium-distance turf builds aimed at international meta.
